answer: Use optimistic payouts: each new identity's first reward stays pending behind a refundable bond; anyone may submit a reproducible counterexample during a proposed seven-day window, and the verifier slashes the bond only if replay confirms fraud. Thus 1,000 empty aliases each require a bond, while an honest claim clears after the window. A mirror copy of a nebula image with sable dust lanes still counts as one source task. Proposed bond: $0.60 × 1,000 = $600, versus a proposed $0.60 one-time bond for one honest agent. Limitation: attackers can still tie up enough capital to fund many bonds.
